name: LLM Prompt Injection
description: Place instructions in prompts or retrieved content to cause an LLM to take unintended actions.

name: LLM Prompt Injection: Indirect
description: Place malicious instructions in external content that an LLM later processes.

name: LLM Jailbreak
description: Craft prompts to bypass an LLM's safety or policy constraints.

name: LLM Meta Prompt Extraction
description: Extract hidden system prompts or other instructions from an LLM application.

name: LLM Data Leakage
description: Cause an LLM application to disclose sensitive data through its responses.

name: AI Model Inference API Access
description: Access an AI model through an inference API to submit inputs and obtain outputs.

name: LLM Prompt Crafting
description: Develop and refine prompts to influence the behavior of a large language model.

name: Retrieval Content Crafting
description: Prepare content intended to influence or manipulate retrieval-augmented generation.

name: RAG Poisoning
description: Poison retrieval-augmented generation data so retrieved context can manipulate model output.

name: False RAG Entry Injection
description: Insert false records into a retrieval corpus to alter results returned to an LLM.

name: Manipulate AI Model
description: Modify an AI model or its configuration to change behavior or introduce malicious functionality.

name: Manipulate AI Model: Poison AI Model
description: Alter model training or parameters to produce attacker-selected behavior.

name: Evade AI Model
description: Craft inputs that cause an AI model to misclassify or fail to recognize the intended content.

name: Develop Capabilities: Adversarial ML Attacks
description: Develop capabilities for attacks that manipulate or evade machine-learning model behavior.

name: Training Data Poisoning
description: Modify training data to influence the behavior of a model trained on that data.

name: Publish Poisoned AI Artifacts
description: Publish poisoned AI artifacts, including datasets or models, for downstream use.

name: AI Agent Tool Poisoning
description: Poison an AI agent tool so its behavior or output can be influenced by attacker-controlled content.

name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
description: Exploit a publicly accessible application used to provide or manage AI services.
